beats: Knowing who'd been contacted, who replied, and who still needed a sample meant juggling spreadsheets with no sense of where anyone stood.
Now every business gets a pin on a live map, built with Leaflet.
Color tells the story at a glance, like traffic lights instead of a spreadsheet row.
A background job checks status on its own, and outreach emails queue and get tracked automatically.
Six towns, one map, every pin tracked instead of lost in a spreadsheet.
